finiteScope.snapshotPolicy: Use one common replication timestamp when available; preserve all four originals, headers, clipping metadata, publisher checksums and locally computed SHA-256. A moving latest URL is not a permanent edition. Dated daily URLs can expire.
finiteScope.territoryPolicy: Intended application scope is 50 states, DC, PR, VI, AS, GU and MP. The four-extract union must be clipped/assigned using authoritative full Census polygons, not download names, ISO labels or bounding boxes. US minor outlying islands outside the existing 56-area Census reference scope remain outside this proposed runtime contract.
metadataAnomalies: Geofabrik index lists us/puerto-rico and us/us-virgin-islands with parent north-america, independently of us. Do not assume the us download includes them because their pages appear in its subregion table.

American Oceania index advertises iso3166-1:alpha2=[VU], inconsistent with its name and clipping extent; this field must not assign country/state. Its broad clipping regions also require actual territorial boundary filtering.
finiteScope.outsidePredicateMeaning: Explicit finite baseline, not a claim to include every physical or planned facility. Disused=yes on power=substation remains in the raw ledger with its source meaning.

availabilityEvidence.meaning: Counts are tag presence/declared classifications, not verified identity, ownership, transmission status or match yield. Node-only production cannot fulfill useful full inventory coverage.

caveats: Element ID is not a planning project ID or engineering station ID; node/way/relation ID spaces are separate.
Timestamp/version describe community edits, not construction, commissioning or current verification.
Names and ref tags are optional; ref namespace/operator identity must be established before cross-source matching.
Operator and owner tags are community observations and never overwrite Project.owner.
Co-located or same-named node/way/relation objects may represent one facility; preserve ambiguity rather than blindly merging physical facilities.

geography.nodeRole: Explicitly unverified community-mapped facility position only, if later accepted; not a construction/equipment center.
geography.waysRelations: No representative centers. Retain actual supported closed-way/multipolygon footprint or derived bounding extent only after a separate facility-area representation contract. Missing members, invalid rings, area=no and non-area relations get explicit unresolved/excluded reasons.
geography.context: Use already preserved Census ACS2025 full EPSG:4326 state/territory polygons and their source hashes for containment/intersection. Existing rectangular reference bounds and Geofabrik clipping buffers cannot establish membership. Boundary conflicts stay ambiguous.
geography.priority: Preferred native/official evidence first; OSM fallback cannot override accepted evidence or become strict-distance eligible.

license.bundlePolicyProposal: Keep the OSM-derived reference database identified and reproducibly downloadable under ODbL with license/attribution notices. Do not treat existing application/code licenses as relicensing OSM. Separate files alone do not establish legal independence of joined datasets.
license.publicUse: ODbL 4.2–4.6 require notices, share-alike for derivative databases, and a machine-readable database or complete alterations/method offer when publicly used, including through a produced work.
license.exports: JSON/CSV database exports containing OSM-derived references need provenance and license notices; visual/report outputs require attribution. Coordinator must define the scope of mixed project/reference exports and the downloadable derivative offer before shipping them.
license.geocodingCaveat: The OSMF exception for individual geocoding results must not be assumed for systematic national aggregation of a feature type. Collective/geocoding rules may preserve independently sourced project fields, but require an explicit accepted data-flow design.

producerRequirements.tools: An approved isolated Osmium Tool or pyosmium runtime. osmium/osmconvert/osmfilter were not present on PATH; no dependency was installed.
producerRequirements.disk: 12,263,617,346 published source bytes plus filtered data/member indexes, derived geometry and immutable snapshots. Peak RAM, elapsed extraction time and compact output size are unmeasured.
producerRequirements.strategy: Sequential checksum-pinned downloads; local streaming nwr/power=substation filtering including referenced geometry members. Count primary tagged elements separately from helper members. Do not retain full-US node locations in a custom in-memory map.

enablingTasks.task: Accept community-evidence status, typed node/footprint/extent geometry, precision/null accuracy, precedence, version/fingerprint guards and ODbL bundle/export boundaries.
enablingTasks.dependency: This qualification; no runtime authorization inferred.

enablingTasks.task: Acquire all four same-edition public PBFs after explicit producer dispatch; preserve checksums/headers/hashes and run a full local candidate/member inventory.
enablingTasks.dependency: Approved isolated tooling and large-source acquisition; finite scope accepted.

enablingTasks.task: Resolve supported geometry and full Census polygon context, retain raw names/classifications and emit all eligible references plus complete disposition ledger.
enablingTasks.dependency: Geometry/context contract. No node-only completion claim.

enablingTasks.task: Consume OSM as an unverified fallback; expose attribution, geometry role, uncertain matches and a downloadable licensed companion through appropriate results/exports.
enablingTasks.dependency: Early producer batch and accepted license/geometry schema; full scope remains open until reconciled.

enablingTasks.task: Run the sole bounded integrated case, including unchanged native evidence, ambiguity, noneligibility for strict distances and licensed exports.

completionCriteria: Every primary element with power=substation in every declared preserved extract has a source identity/version and disposition; helper geometry members are counted separately.
Cross-extract same-type/native-ID duplicates reconcile; identical editions agree on version/content, conflicts are not silently resolved by arbitrary newest choice.

Unique candidates = emitted point/area references + explicit excluded/unresolved reasons; report raw occurrences, unique IDs, duplicate occurrences, element types, source-state categories and zero unexplained rows.
Exact official polygon evidence supports territorial/state context; unnamed, incompatible, boundary-crossing and duplicate-facility cases preserve ambiguity and unknowns.
All footprints preserve members/holes or explicit failure; no generated center or numerical accuracy enters runtime. Source snapshot revisions invalidate affected stale enrichments.

Machine-readable ODbL reference bundle/license offer and visible attribution are connected, including export provenance; no raw private project material is published to satisfy a reference-data license.
No predicted match yield or metadata-statistics sum is represented as completed ingestion or real-world facility completeness.

originals.failureResolution: An initially guessed Collective Database guideline URL returned 404; the canonical official linked guideline was preserved successfully. OSM copyright web-reader timeout resolved through official /copyright/en. No access restriction was bypassed.
